title: PH set to host inaugural U-19 Asian Sepaktakraw Championship
summary: The Philippines will host the inaugural edition of the ASTAF U-19 Asian Sepaktakraw Championship on November 26-30 at the Rizal Memorial Sports Coliseum and Ninoy Aquino Stadium in Manila.
